title: Dragons of Tarkir Promos: card flavor text

entities.name: Anafenza, Kin-Tree Spirit
entities.description: A spirit who was martyred for worshipping her ancestors and now walks among them.

entities.name: Urdnan
entities.description: A Dromoka warrior who trusts in the scalelords.

entities.name: Siara
entities.description: The Dragon's Mouth, who speaks of Silumgar's mind as a dark labyrinth.

entities.name: Dromoka
entities.description: A dragon clan whose ideals are strength, unity, and honor and whose dragons foster trust among their subjects.

entities.name: Dragonlord Silumgar
entities.description: A dragonlord whose mind is a dark labyrinth and who never passes up an opportunity to add to his opulence.

entities.name: Dragonlord Dromoka
entities.description: A dragonlord whose followers forsake blood ties to join a greater family.

entities.name: Dragonlord Atarka
entities.description: A dragonlord; feeding her is held as the greatest honor.

entities.name: Surrak, the Hunt Caller
entities.description: A warrior who holds that the greatest honor is to feed Atarka.

entities.name: Kolaghan
entities.description: A dragon clan whose attacks are likened to repeated lightning strikes.

entities.name: Atarka
entities.description: A dragon clan whose dragons' exhale cooks what their inhale consumes.

entities.name: Dragonlord Ojutai
entities.description: A dragonlord whose brood's elite are the skywise.

entities.name: Skywise
entities.description: The elite of Ojutai's brood, who see their enemies as puzzles to be solved.

entities.name: Scalelords
entities.description: Dromoka dragons trusted as bringers of justice that none can escape.

events.summary: Anafenza was martyred for worshipping her ancestors and now walks among them as a spirit.
